title: Normalized storyline (common representation for all conditions)

governing_thought.description: The single sentence the deck states as its overall answer, copied verbatim. null if the deck never states one.

executive_summary.description: The executive-summary points as written (verbatim), in order. Empty if the deck has no executive summary.

claim.description: A claim the slide makes, verbatim or near-verbatim

evidence.description: The numbers, data or facts the slide gives for that claim, verbatim

recommendation.description: The strategic recommendation as stated, verbatim or closely paraphrased with the deck's own words. null if none.

treatment.description: What the deck says about this alternative (verbatim/closely paraphrased): chosen, rejected and why, etc.

assumptions_and_uncertainties.description: Assumptions, risks and uncertainties the deck states explicitly

extraction_notes.description: Anything that could not be extracted cleanly (e.g. unreadable pictures). No judgement of quality.
